commander_identity.mechanical_plan: Anhelo ({U}{B}{R} 1/3 deathtouch) gives the first instant or sorcery we cast in EVERY turn casualty 2: sacrifice a power-2+ creature to copy it. The deck chains cheap interaction, tutors, rituals and combo spells (Reiterate, Twinflame, Narset's Reversal, Jeska's Will, Mana Geyser, Time Warp) and needs a steady supply of power-2+ bodies; magecraft/cast payoffs (Storm-Kiln, Ral, Deekah, Talrand, Veyran, Archmage) turn copies into mana, damage and cards.
commander_identity.natural_ceiling: Power Bracket 4 - Optimized: seven Game Changers (Cyclonic Rift, Demonic Tutor, Fierce Guardianship, Jeska's Will, Mystical Tutor, Underworld Breach, Vampiric Tutor), two-card infinite combos and Time Warp; not cEDH-tuned (no fast mana beyond Sol Ring/Dark Ritual).
commander_identity.anti_homogenization: Every add is either casualty fodder that recurs from the graveyard or an instant that exploits opponent-turn casualty; generic spellslinger goodstuff and token-making instants that eat the casualty slot themselves were rejected.

whole_deck_audit.roles_and_overlaps: All 99 reviewed by quantity: 34 physical lands (25 nonbasic + 3 Island + 3 Mountain + 3 Swamp; closeout's '31 lands' was a row count), 9 static rocks, 20 instants, 11 sorceries, 17 noncommander creatures, 5 enchantments, Ral. Overlap: 43 static mana sources plus Dark Ritual, Cormela, Big Score, BMC and Storm-Kiln Treasures is excess for avg nonland MV 2.83; casualty fodder (power 2+) was thin and much of it came from instants (Startle) that consume the casualty slot.
whole_deck_audit.mana_base_and_curve: Baseline 34 lands + 9 rocks = 43 static sources. Candidate 33 lands + 6 rocks (Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Dimir/Izzet/Rakdos Signet, Talisman of Creativity) = 39, plus Dark Ritual, Treasure makers and three reducers. Curve shifts toward 2-drop creatures (+4 two-drops, -3 two-mana rocks/-1 land). Pips U37 B23 R28 baseline; candidate adds B-heavy bodies (B+5 pips incl. Bedevil BB) and removes Feed the Swarm B; black land sources remain >= 18.
whole_deck_audit.interaction_resilience: Stack: Counterspell, Mana Drain, Fierce Guardianship, Deflecting Swat, An Offer You Can't Refuse, Narset's Reversal; removal: Bedevil (new, instant), Chaos Warp, Cyclonic Rift, Deadly Rollick, Crackle, Toxic Deluge, Otawara, Sinister Concierge (temporary); graveyard resilience improved by three graveyard-recastable bodies.

material_candidates.source: EDHREC High Lift top entry (1084 Anhelo decks); live Scryfall Oracle
material_candidates.role: Recursive power-3 casualty fodder: 3/1 for {1}{B}, castable from the graveyard on your turn after a land enters
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses the ninth static rock (a colorless-or-opponent-colored Fellwar); 33 lands + 6 rocks remain plus Dark Ritual, Treasure makers and three cost reducers.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Anhelo's casualty 2 needs a power-2+ body every turn; Shade is a 3-power body that returns for {1}{B} on any of our turns with a land drop (3 fetches, Otawara and Morphic Pool are irrelevant; every land counts), so one card fuels many casualty copies. Its nontoken death also triggers Ghoulish Procession.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Cannot block; only recastable on our own turn after landfall, so it does not refuel opponent-turn casualty if we lack a body; can be exiled by graveyard hate.
material_candidates.reason: Best fodder-per-card available in color: repeatable, cheap, and power 3 (kicked 5/3 late).

material_candidates.source: EDHREC creatures section (2426 Anhelo decks); live Scryfall Oracle
material_candidates.role: Power-2 fodder that turns its own death into tempo removal and self-recursion via suspend
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses the B/R Talisman; Rakdos Signet, Arcane Signet and Command Tower/fixing lands still cover B/R.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: When sacrificed to casualty, Concierge exiles itself with three time counters and exiles up to one opposing creature (blocker/combo piece) for three turns, then recasts itself free with haste: one card is casualty fodder twice plus removal.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Exiled opposing creature returns with haste in three turns; the 2/1 body dies to everything; delayed value.
material_candidates.reason: Fodder that also interacts; strictly more per sacrifice than a mana rock gives in this list.

material_candidates.source: EDHREC High Lift (2218 Anhelo decks); live Scryfall Oracle
material_candidates.role: Power-2 fodder with surveil 2 and repeatable return to hand
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Land count 34 -> 33 (Exotic Orchard is the land most dependent on opponents' colors); untapped U/B/R sources stay above 20 each.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Surveil 2 stocks the graveyard for Kess, Maestros Ascendancy, Snapcaster, Underworld Breach and Galvanic flashback; every opponent second draw per turn (common in multiplayer, and our own Jeska's Will/opponent wheels) returns it to hand for the next casualty.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Return depends on opponents drawing a second card in a turn; 2/1 body; surveil is setup, not card advantage.
material_candidates.reason: Recurring fodder plus graveyard setup; the 34th land is the lowest-value mana slot.

material_candidates.source: OFF-RANKING: not shown on the Anhelo EDHREC page; found by searching black recursive power-2+ creatures; live Scryfall Oracle
material_candidates.role: Recursive power-3 fodder: blitz from the graveyard for {2}{B}{B} + 2 life, draws a card when the blitzed creature dies
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses the third Talisman (U/B already covered by Dimir Signet, Arcane Signet, Underground Sea, Watery Grave, etc.); 6 rocks remain.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Blitzed Underdog is a hasty 3/2 that we sacrifice to casualty before end step: copy the spell AND draw a card from its dies trigger, then repeat from the graveyard on a later turn. Nontoken death also triggers Ghoulish Procession.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Blitz is sorcery-timing (our main phase only) and costs 2 life per loop; four mana per reuse.
material_candidates.reason: Off-ranking find that turns fodder into card advantage every time; best value per sacrifice among examined bodies.

material_candidates.source: Grixis removal staple; live Scryfall Oracle; examined as instant-speed upgrade
material_candidates.role: Instant removal: destroy target artifact, creature or planeswalker
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses enchantment removal and sorcery-speed creature removal; Chaos Warp, Cyclonic Rift and Otawara still answer enchantments/any permanent.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: As an instant it can be the first instant on an opponent's turn, so Anhelo's casualty copies it there (two removal hits for one card), which Feed the Swarm (sorcery) can only do on our turn; hits artifacts/planeswalkers that threaten us; no life loss.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: BBR pips in a three-colour deck; no enchantment hit.
material_candidates.reason: Instant speed doubles the value of the commander's every-turn casualty window; broader permanent coverage matters more than enchantments here.

material_candidates.role: Reducer + lets sorceries be cast at flash speed
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Would replace a two-mana flying reducer with a four-mana body.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Flashing sorceries means Demonic Tutor, Time Warp, Army of the Damned or Twinflame can be the first spell on an opponent's turn with casualty; it is itself a 3-power body.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Four-drop slot competes with Archmage Emeritus, Kess, Storm-Kiln Artist, Ral; raises curve; dies easily.
material_candidates.reason: Genuine commander synergy, staged as a six-swap full-100, but not clearly better than the cheaper Drake that also uses commander-cast copies.

material_candidates.role: Land that returns an instant/sorcery to the top of the library
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Would replace an untapped U/R dual with a mono-U land.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Rebuys a combo piece (Reiterate, Twinflame, Jeska's Will) once.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Only 3 basic Islands plus typed duals (Underground Sea, Volcanic Island, Watery Grave, Steam Vents...) -- enters untapped only with three other Islands, worse early; loses red.
material_candidates.reason: Mana quality loss outweighs a one-shot top-deck recursion; deck already has Kess, Ascendancy, Snapcaster, Breach.

material_candidates.source: Recursive fodder search; live Scryfall Oracle
material_candidates.role: 1-mana 2/1 castable from graveyard while controlling a Zombie
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Would cut either the last Talisman or a copy enabler.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Jadar, Ghoulish Procession, Poppet Stitcher and Startle make Zombie tokens, so it is often recastable.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Requires a Zombie in play; decayed tokens are sacrificed after attacking; weaker than Shade/Underdog without that support.
material_candidates.reason: Conditional recursion; the selected bodies are unconditional.

material_candidates.source: Spellslinger card-draw staple; live Scryfall Oracle
material_candidates.role: Instant: discard, draw two, two Treasures
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Would remove the Reiterate + Mana Geyser infinite-mana line.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Instant at opponent end step with casualty copy = draw four, four Treasures.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Mana Geyser is a combo piece (Reiterate buyback with 7+ opponent tapped lands); Big Score already fills the Windfall role.
material_candidates.reason: Combo redundancy and Big Score overlap.

material_candidates.source: EDHREC High Lift; live Scryfall Oracle
material_candidates.role: 1-mana 2/1 that returns from graveyard after a non-Skeleton died
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Would cut Cormela's instant mana and dies-recursion.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Returns cheaply after a casualty sacrifice of another creature.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Enters tapped; needs another creature death the same turn; does not refuel when it is the only body.
material_candidates.reason: Weaker than the selected bodies and Cormela gives ritual mana plus spell recursion.

material_candidates.source: Magecraft token maker; live Scryfall Oracle
material_candidates.role: 3-mana 3/2 menace ward; makes Pests on cast or copy
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Would cut Ral, the deck's copy-count damage outlet.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Pests are only 1/1 (not casualty-legal); Witch herself is 3-power fodder.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Pest tokens cannot pay casualty 2; Ral converts Narset/Reiterate loops into a win.
material_candidates.reason: Ral is a combo kill outlet; Witch's tokens miss the commander's power threshold.

material_candidates.source: EDHREC High Lift; live Scryfall Oracle
material_candidates.role: 1-mana instant: graveyard hate + 2/2 decayed Zombie, flashback
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Makes a power-2 decayed Zombie that is legal casualty fodder.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: As an instant it consumes the turn's first-spell casualty slot itself, so its token arrives too late for that turn's casualty; no card draw.
material_candidates.reason: Commander-specific anti-synergy shared with Startle; Startle at least cantrips.

material_candidates.source: EDHREC High Lift; live Scryfall Oracle
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Would cut Toxic Deluge, the deck's only full board wipe.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Spends the first-spell slot; token count depends on opposing graveyards.
material_candidates.reason: Same first-spell anti-synergy; Deluge is irreplaceable interaction.

material_candidates.source: EDHREC High Lift; previously cut in canonical refinement
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Would cut Galvanic Iteration, a two-use copy enabler.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Two casualty-legal fliers; copied it makes four.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Four-mana sorcery that uses the first-spell slot; canonical approval already removed it.
material_candidates.reason: Lower value than permanent recursive bodies; consumes casualty slot.

material_candidates.role: Enchantment: copy the first instant/sorcery each turn
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Would cut Galvanic Iteration, a cheap two-use copy effect.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Stacks with the casualty copy for a third copy of the first spell.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Six-mana do-nothing-alone enchantment; owner approval preferred the current list.
material_candidates.reason: Too slow for Bracket 4: six mana that does nothing on its own.

material_candidates.role: RR instant: copy target instant or sorcery
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Would cut Galvanic Iteration and its flashback second use.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Copies opponents' spells too; Narset's Reversal-style flexibility.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Galvanic Iteration has flashback (two uses, Kess/Breach friendly) and a copy that is itself copied by casualty when Galvanic is the first spell; Reverberate is one-shot.
material_candidates.reason: Sidegrade; flashback is the deciding value.

material_candidates.role: Sorcery: opponents sacrifice a chosen pile
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Would cut the reliable board wipe.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Copyable with casualty for two edicts each.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Opponents choose piles; Deluge sweeps everything for 3 mana and does not hit our recursive bodies permanently.
material_candidates.reason: Less reliable than the incumbent wipe.

material_candidates.source: Spellslinger token engine; live Scryfall Oracle
material_candidates.role: Enchantment making X/X Constructs per spell
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Five-mana UU enchantment; copies are not cast so casualty copies add nothing; BMC already makes a 3/2 body each turn.
material_candidates.reason: Slower than BMC for the same fodder role.

material_candidates.role: X-cost drain finisher that gains life
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Would cut Crackle with Power, a flexible removal/finisher.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Copyable by casualty for a doubled drain on our turn.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Crackle hits creatures/planeswalkers as well and Torment of Hailfire is already an X sink.
material_candidates.reason: Overlaps the existing X finishers with less flexibility.

final_changes.coherent_package_tradeoff: Five one-for-one swaps: four excess mana slots (Fellwar Stone, two Talismans, Exotic Orchard) become recursive power-2+ casualty fodder (Skyclave Shade, Sinister Concierge, Dogged Detective, Tenacious Underdog) and sorcery Feed the Swarm becomes instant Bedevil. Costs: 34->33 lands and 9->6 rocks, slightly lower Storm-Kiln power, no enchantment hit from Feed the Swarm. Gains: the commander's every-turn copy is fed by bodies that come back, and removal can be copied on opponents' turns.

low_swap_heightened_audit.off_ranked_opportunities: OFF-RANKING: Tenacious Underdog (selected); Gravecrawler, Reverberate, Make an Example, Exsanguinate, Metallurgic Summonings (rejected); Wizards of Thay (staged alternative).

multi_slot_packages.result_and_rationale: Selected five-swap package: mana excess converted into recursive fodder plus an instant removal upgrade.
Six-swap alternative staged as full 100; retained as alternative, not clearly better.
Seven-swap alternative staged as full 100; rejected for breaking the Geyser combo and conditional recursion.

low_swap_heightened_audit.alternate_cuts_for_prior_holds: Tenacious Underdog was also tested over Primal Amulet (five-swap alternative, keeps Talisman of Dominance); rejected because Wellspring is a repeatable copy engine.
low_swap_heightened_audit.strongest_argument_against_baseline: The commander copies one spell every turn only if we can sacrifice a power-2+ creature, yet the approved list spends nine slots on rocks and 34 on lands while much of its fodder comes from instants that use up the casualty slot themselves.
low_swap_heightened_audit.evidence_based_answer: Trade four redundant mana slots for four creatures that recur from the graveyard or hand, and swap the sorcery removal for an instant that the commander can copy on opponents' turns.

final_candidate.deckwide_reconciliation: Exact copy of the physical canonical source order with five in-place substitutions; MDFC/transform lines keep the source's full ' // ' names; 33 lands, 6 rocks, 100 physical cards verified by quantity.

owner_authority.owner_approval_question: This deck is complete. Do you approve it?

open_ended_optimization_audit.remaining_99_review: After the five, the remaining slots were re-challenged: combo core (Reiterate, Twinflame, Dualcaster, Narset's Reversal, Twinning Staff, Geyser, Jeska's Will) protected; payoffs (Ral, Storm-Kiln, Deekah, Talrand, Veyran, Archmage) kept; reducers (Drake, Electromancer, Amulet) kept; lands rechecked (Training Center, Morphic Pool, Otawara); interaction (Deluge, Rollick, Crackle) and fodder creatures (Cormela, Judith, Lagomos, Jadar) challenged with named replacements.

post_floor_challenges.tradeoff: Wizards adds sorcery-flash for opponent-turn casualty but costs four; Drake is a 2-mana flying reducer and casualty body whose sac copy scales with commander casts. Kept Drake; staged six-swap alternative.
Sanctuary's one rebuy does not pay for losing an untapped U/R source with only three basic Islands in a 33-land list.
Windfall is better alone but Geyser is the Reiterate infinite-mana piece and Big Score already covers the Windfall role.
Witch's 1/1 Pests cannot pay casualty 2; Ral is the damage outlet for Narset/Reiterate/Twinning loops.
Both instants consume the first-spell casualty slot when they make the token; Startle draws a card, so it stays.
Flashback makes Galvanic two copy effects and it fuels Kess/Breach; Reverberate is a one-shot sidegrade.
Opponent-chosen piles are unreliable versus a three-mana full wipe; our recursive fodder recovers from Deluge.
Conscript enters tapped and needs another death; Cormela makes UBR for spells and rebuys a spell on death.

larger_swap_packages.case_for_extra_swaps: Sorcery flash lets tutors, Time Warp, Twinflame and Army of the Damned be the first spell on opponents' turns for a casualty copy; Wizards is a 3-power body.
larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: Raises the curve by two for a slot that already reduces costs, flies and copies via commander-cast count; marginal, not clearly better.

larger_swap_packages.case_for_extra_swaps: One-shot top-of-library recursion of Reiterate/Twinflame/Jeska's Will from a land slot.
larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: Mono-U, often tapped early with only three basic Islands; loses red; recursion is already abundant (Kess, Ascendancy, Snapcaster, Breach).

larger_swap_packages.case_for_extra_swaps: More instant-speed card flow and Treasure plus another one-mana recursive body for casualty.
larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: Breaks the Reiterate + Mana Geyser line, duplicates Big Score, and Gravecrawler's Zombie condition is weaker than the selected unconditional bodies.

open_ended_optimization_audit.quality_based_stop_reason: Stopped at five because every further challenger examined either broke a combo line (Windfall over Geyser), lowered mana quality (Mystic Sanctuary), shared the instant-token anti-synergy (Rotten Reunion, Waste Management), missed the power-2 threshold (Sedgemoor Witch Pests) or was only a sidegrade (Wizards of Thay, Reverberate); none was clearly better than its incumbent.
